lines.en: there will be a scarcity of water and fatal disease in the province of Turkistan, and this conjunction in auspiciousness is lesser than other

lines.en: of evil, and the repentance of evildoers, and the becoming good of affairs, and the moderation of the weather, and the safety of roads. Muhyi al-Din Maghribi

lines.text: گوید قتل یکی از فرماندهان روم وقوت حال اغنام وقلت طعام در سواد عراق وسواحل
lines.en: says: the killing of one of the commanders of Rome, and the strength of the condition of sheep, and the scarcity of food in the rural areas of Iraq and the coasts,

lines.text: ایجاد کی فوائد مطربان و تاریکی هوا ونیکی حال خواتین وسایر زنان وبودن نم اکر
lines.en: the creation of benefits for musicians, and the darkness of the weather, and the goodness of the condition of ladies and other women, and the presence of moisture. If

lines.text: مشتری مستعلی باشد نیکی حال سال بود ومرك کاو وکوسفند وکثرت مرغ وماهی وحدوث
lines.en: Jupiter is elevated, it will be the goodness of the condition of the year, and the death of cows and sheep, and the abundance of birds and fish, and the occurrence of

lines.en: earthquakes, and the scarcity of waters. And if Venus is elevated, the king of Rome will put to death some of the grandees of his kingdom.

lines.text: بقتل رساند وافت رسد بزمین بابل (مقارنه سعدین در مثلثه هوائی) دلالت کند بر
lines.en: (The conjunction of the two benefics in the airy triplicity) indicates

lines.text: قوت حال ادیان خاصه اسلامیان وجمعیتها ی خیر ورفتن مردم بمزارات متبرکه واجابت
lines.en: the strength of the condition of religions, especially Muslims, and gatherings of goodness, and people going to blessed shrines, and the answering of

lines.text: دعاها وراستی وامانت در مردم ولهو وطرب در اشراف وقیمت عطرها ولباسها ورفتن
lines.en: prayers, and truthfulness and trustworthiness among people, and amusement and joy among the nobles, and the price of perfumes and clothes, and the going of

lines.text: بادها وخوشی وتندرستی خلایق وبسیاری نباتات واطعمه وانما ر وفراخی وارزانی
lines.en: winds, and the happiness and health of the creatures, and the abundance of plants and foods and fruits, and spaciousness and cheapness,

lines.text: وبارندکی ورونق رواج احکام شرعیه وتوبه مفسدان وبدکاران وایمنی وموافقت
lines.en: and raining, and the flourishing of the currency of religious rulings, and the repentance of the corrupt and evildoers, and safety, and agreement

lines.text: ازواج ورفتن ابرهای روشن در وقت ونیکی احوال نصاری وارامنه (واکر در جوزا
lines.en: of spouses, and the going of bright clouds in time, and the goodness of the conditions of Christians and Armenians. (And if it is in Gemini)

lines.text: بود) دلالت کند بر قوت اهل اسلام وبسیاری خیرات واجابت ادعیه ووقوع نکاحها
lines.en: it indicates the strength of the people of Islam, and the abundance of charities, and the answering of prayers, and the occurrence of marriages,

lines.text: وبسیاری توالد میمون ومبارك وطرب در وزراء وعظما وصحت بیماران واصلاح احوال
lines.en: and the abundance of auspicious and blessed births, and joy among viziers and grandees, and the health of the sick, and the improvement of the conditions

lines.text: زنان وکثرت فوائد مطربان وفرح ملوك وخواتین وشادی حکام فارس وقوت کرفتن
lines.en: of women, and the abundance of benefits for musicians, and the joy of kings and ladies, and the happiness of the rulers of Fars, and the gaining of strength

lines.text: اهل حق ومقهوری اهل باطل اکر مشتری مستعلی بود صلاح حال پادشاه عراق وعزت
lines.en: of the people of truth, and the subjugation of the people of falsehood. If Jupiter is elevated, it will be the goodness of the condition of the king of Iraq, and the honor

lines.text: شدن یکی از بزرکان ارمنیه ببلاد المر و کمی باران وبسیاری کشت واکر زهره مستعلی
lines.en: of one of the grandees of Armenia in the lands of Al-Murr, and the scarcity of rain, and the abundance of crops. And if Venus is elevated,

lines.text: بود فساد حال اهواز وخوزستان باشد وهلاك بزرکی از ان ولایت (واکر در میزان
lines.en: it will be the corruption of the condition of Ahvaz and Khuzestan, and the perishing of a grandee from that province. (And if it is in Libra)

lines.en: it indicates the goodness of the condition of merchants, and the abundance of benefits for judges and jurists and musicians, and many diseases

summary.headline: Omens of Benefic Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological omens for the conjunction of the two benefics in Capricorn and the airy triplicity, especially Gemini and Libra, covering weather, disease, rainfall, crops, rulers, religions, marriages, merchants, and regional conditions. Muhyi al-Din Maghribi is cited for additional predictions concerning Rome, Iraq, Armenia, Ahvaz, and Khuzestan.
